source_notes: Pre-FID project; anticipated FID has slipped from 2025 to 2026. As of 2026 the consortium (Nisga'a Nation, Rockies LNG, Western LNG; TotalEnergies 5% equity) is targeting FID in 2026 (variously reported as 'summer 2026' / 'by year's end'); a Western LNG spokesperson confirmed they expect to sanction before the end of the year. Project still needs 3-4 mtpa additional offtake to cross the FID threshold (a non-binding 1 mtpa SEFE/Germany deal announced May 2026). FIDStatus remains Pre-FID. Yellow because the precise 2026 month is contested and FID is still contingent on offtake.
